entries.clue: Tall upright spar rising from the deck to carry sail
Huge balloon of light nylon bellied out ahead when the wind is behind
Distress letters the operators tapped out alongside the older call CQD
Cheapest quarters low in the ship; three of every four booked there were lost
Lazy loop a river swings through flat country
Great Atlantic passenger ship of the kind Lusitania and Mauretania also were
Tall stack rising above her; she carried four, and the last was a dummy
Shallow crossing where a country lane runs straight through a river
Sheltered basin of pontoons where pleasure craft keep their berths
Weighted fin down a boat's centreline that resists sideways slip
Fine mud a slackening river drops, choking a channel over years
Drifting mountain calved off a Greenland glacier, sighted with no time to spare
Gravelly bottom a river runs along; you sleep in one too
Nomadic served as hers at Cherbourg, carrying passengers out to where she lay
